selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of generalized painful fluid-filled skin lesions, yellow scleral discoloration, and fever following medication use, along with laboratory findings of elevated liver enzymes and bilirubin, supports the diagnosis of Drug-induced Stevens-Johnson syndrome, which is a severe cutaneous adverse reaction.

rejected.label: Acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis
rejected.why: The presence of bullae and hemorrhagic lip crusts is more characteristic of Stevens-Johnson syndrome than pustulosis.

rejected.label: Severe cutaneous adverse reaction
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes Stevens-Johnson syndrome, but the specific findings in this case support the more specific diagnosis of Drug-induced Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
